Best laptops for NUS students

Choosing a laptop for university is not easy. In this guide we compare battery life, weight and keyboard quality across the most popular models students bring to lectures, and explain which ones survive a full day of classes without a charger. We also cover warranty options in Singapore and whether the student discount portals are worth using.

The short version: buy something light with a good battery, and do not overspend on graphics unless you game. Most computing modules run fine on any modern machine, and the labs have workstations anyway.
